# Vamsa - Family Tree Application

A modern web application for building and visualizing family trees.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 with App Router
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
- **Testing**: Vitest (unit) + Playwright (e2e)

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+ or Bun
- PostgreSQL database

### Installation

1. Clone the repository
2. Install dependencies:
```bash
bun install
```

3. Set up environment variables:
```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

4. Run database migrations:
```bash
bunx prisma migrate dev
```

5. Start the development server:
```bash
bun dev
```

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── actions/ # Server actions
├── app/ # Next.js app router pages
├── components/ # React components
├── hooks/ # Custom React hooks
├── lib/ # Utility functions and configurations
├── schemas/ # Zod validation schemas
└── types/ # TypeScript type definitions
```

## Features

- Create and manage family members
- Visualize family relationships in a tree view
- Search and filter family members
- Backup and restore family data
- User authentication

// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

// Looking for ways to speed up your queries, or scale easily with your serverless or edge functions?
// Try Prisma Accelerate: https://pris.ly/cli/accelerate-init

generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = ["driverAdapters"]
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Account {
  id                String  @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String
  type              String
  provider          String
  providerAccountId String
  refresh_token     String? @db.Text
  access_token      String? @db.Text
  expires_at        Int?
  token_type        String?
  scope             String?
  id_token          String? @db.Text
  session_state     String?

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])
}

model Session {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  sessionToken String   @unique
  userId       String
  expires      DateTime
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model User {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  name          String?
  email         String?   @unique
  emailVerified DateTime?
  image         String?
  accounts      Account[]
  sessions      Session[]
}

model VerificationToken {
  identifier String
  token      String   @unique
  expires    DateTime

  @@unique([identifier, token])
}

model Person {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  firstName   String
  lastName    String?
  birthDate   DateTime?
  deathDate   DateTime?
  gender      Gender?
  birthPlace  String?
  deathPlace  String?
  occupation  String?
  bio         String?   @db.Text
  photoUrl    String?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Family relationships
  fatherId String?
  father   Person?  @relation("FatherChildren", fields: [fatherId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  children Person[] @relation("FatherChildren")

  motherId        String?
  mother          Person?  @relation("MotherChildren", fields: [motherId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  motherChildren  Person[] @relation("MotherChildren")

  // Spouse relationships (many-to-many)
  spouses   Person[] @relation("Spouses")
  spousesOf Person[] @relation("Spouses")

  @@index([firstName, lastName])
  @@index([fatherId])
  @@index([motherId])
}

enum Gender {
  MALE
  FEMALE
  OTHER
}

## Vamsa - Family Tree Application

**Purpose**: A web application for building and visualizing family trees.

### Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 with App Router and Turbopack
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js
- **UI**: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Radix UI
- **Visualization**: @xyflow/react (for tree visualization)
- **Testing**: Bun test (unit) + Playwright (e2e)
- **Runtime**: Bun

### Key Features
- Person management (CRUD operations)
- Family relationships (parents, children, spouses)
- Family tree visualization
- Backup and restore functionality
- User authentication

### Project Structure
```
src/
├── actions/       - Server actions (backup, restore, people)
├── app/           - Next.js App Router pages
│   ├── (dashboard)/ - Main authenticated routes
│   └── api/         - API routes
├── components/    - React components (admin, person, tree, ui)
├── hooks/         - Custom React hooks
├── lib/           - Utilities (backup, db, utils)
├── schemas/       - Zod validation schemas
└── types/         - TypeScript definitions
```

### Data Model
- **User/Account/Session**: NextAuth authentication models
- **Person**: Core entity with fields for personal info (name, dates, bio, photo) and family relationships (father, mother, spouses via self-referential relations)

### Critical Files for Implementation
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/prisma/schema.prisma` - Database schema defining all models
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/src/actions/people.ts` - Server actions for person CRUD
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/src/components/tree/family-tree.tsx` - Tree visualization component
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/src/lib/db.ts` - Database connection utility
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/src/schemas/person.test.ts` - Person validation schemas
